subject.title: fix(qa): reject runtime tool intent without result evidence

question: Should the runtime-tool release gate require only the three remaining dynamically exposed tools, with the nine Codex-native or unavailable rows retained as report-only diagnostics?
rationale: The code makes a deliberate release-validation policy change by demoting required coverage rows; source review can validate implementation consistency, but maintainers own the permanent readiness contract.

options.title: Accept the narrowed required set
options.body: Treat `session_status`, `web_fetch`, and `web_search` as the required successful-evidence contract and keep unsupported/native rows report-only.

options.title: Keep additional rows required
options.body: Name the additional product tool exposures that must produce canonical successful evidence, then update fixtures and live proof accordingly.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrowed required set
recommendation.body: Treat `session_status`, `web_fetch`, and `web_search` as the required successful-evidence contract and keep unsupported/native rows report-only.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the immediately preceding merged collector on which the proposed evidence policy is built.
